responsibility: Primary MinGW-w64 target configuration header for x86, defining the Windows-specific CPP, assembler, linker, startup, library, multilib, and entry-point specs used by GCC on mingw-w64 systems. It also handles large-address-aware and dynamicbase linker policy, libgcc and pthread runtime selection, Unicode startup support, and target libc feature queries, making it the main OS/ABI adaptation layer for the mingw-w64 family.
same_name_distinction: The MinGW-w64 target-spec header that implements Windows-specific CPP, startfile, linker, and library spec macros; unlike mingw-w64.opt, which only declares the target switch metadata, this header consumes that option in specs such as %{municode:...}.
